review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for this frozen C input. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, DEC-001 and both task keys are preserved. A material unresolved DEC-001 in paired B must still block at decisions before later prerequisites. The existing delay calculation supports the specified rounding, decreasing-factor behavior, zero delay and budget cap; the hook requirements clearly address synchronous cancellation and thrown-value precedence. The task split requires independent verification after implementation and implementation/verification coverage of every required AC. The allowed agents have matching delivery roles, available capacity and supplied active trusted claims for the relevant capabilities; pending legacy claims and Personas are not used as authority. The selected planning reviewer is distinct from the implementer, and the frozen policy permits a verifier to serve that read-only planning role. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree, and the provenance explains the distinct original, normalized saved PRD, manifest and evaluation-source digest domains. Model, sampling, budgets and metric-policy identity are frozen. Original preparation flags are distinguishable from expected planning readiness and do not authorize execution. No candidate results informed this review. Digests and saved-input bindings are accepted as Service-calculated evidence; I did not recompute hashes, execute code or independently attest the recorded human confirmations.
